description: Use whenever a change would break something a client already depends on in a Dotkernel project — renaming or removing a field, parameter, route or template variable; changing a type, status code or response shape; making an optional field required; deprecating or deleting an endpoint — or when someone proposes a /v2, a version prefix, a version header, or "versioning the API". Also use when working with ResourceDeprecation, Sunset and Link headers, or the deprecation middleware.
